statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
The service was ordered to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The services are related to diagnoses R00.2 and R42.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered.
